description:
A dangerous romance between a princess trying to hide her zombie family and a crown prince bent on exposing it! On their way to their youngest sibling's academy entrance ceremony, the Walker family is killed in an unfortunate accident, except for Emily. Emily uses the powers of a warlock she's kept hidden for so long to resurrect her dead siblings as zombies. The problem is that the warlock is a public enemy on the continent, so Emily, as the crown prince's secretary, must keep this entire matter a secret! While Emily must live in hiding, the crown prince Tristan keeps asking Emily for help in hunting down the warlock...

Will Emily be able to carry out the prince's plan without revealing the identities of her zombie family?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
